verdict.rationale: Feitian FIDO Keys are hardware authenticators that work through touch, fingerprint, or plug-in over HID/NFC/BLE, so natural-language command operation is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the keys or their management tools (SK Manager, iePassManager) offer any natural-language or AI-driven interface that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
